## Full Runtime Environment Analysis - Fortanix Baklava Design System

I've thoroughly explored the codebase and documented everything you need to understand the runtime environment. Here's my complete findings:

### 1. ENTRY POINTS & APP INITIALIZATION

**Entry Point File**: `/Users/kasperpeulen/code/storybook/storybook-eval/trials/2026-04-03T11-32-22Z-17399b74/project/app/main.tsx`
- Mounts React app to `#app-root` via `ReactDOM.createRoot()`
- Imports CSS from `/src/styling/main.css`
- Renders `<App/>` component
- App wraps `<Demo/>` component

**HTML Entry**: `/Users/kasperpeulen/code/storybook/storybook-eval/trials/2026-04-03T11-32-22Z-17399b74/project/app/index.html`
- Single div with id="app-root"
- Script module loads main.tsx

**Demo Page**: `/Users/kasperpeulen/code/storybook/storybook-eval/trials/2026-04-03T11-32-22Z-17399b74/project/app/Demo.tsx`
- Uses AppLayout with Header, Sidebar, Content, Footer slots
- Imports: Link, Icon, Panel, FortanixLogo, UserMenu, AccountSelector, SolutionSelector, Header, Sidebar, Nav, Breadcrumbs

### 2. PROVIDERS & CONTEXTS

**Main Provider**: `/Users/kasperpeulen/code/storybook/storybook-eval/trials/2026-04-03T11-32-22Z-17399b74/project/src/context/BaklavaProvider.tsx`
- Wraps app with `TopLayerManager` (tracks modal dialog states) and `ToastProvider` (global notifications)
- Hook: `useDevicePixelRatioTracker()` - tracks device pixel ratio and sets CSS custom property `--bk-device-pixel-ratio`
- Uses `React.use()` for context access
- No context providers in preview (preview.tsx is minimal)

**TopLayerManager**: `/Users/kasperpeulen/code/storybook/storybook-eval/trials/2026-04-03T11-32-22Z-17399b74/project/src/components/util/overlays/TopLayerManager.tsx`
- Observable pattern implementation with `ModalDialogStackObservable` class
- Tracks open modal dialogs in a stack (last-in-first-out)
- Hooks: `usePopoverTracker()`, `useModalDialogTracker()`, `useActiveModalDialog()`
- Maintains focus management for modal dialogs

**ToastProvider/Notifier**: `/Users/kasperpeulen/code/storybook/storybook-eval/trials/2026-04-03T11-32-22Z-17399b74/project/src/components/overlays/ToastProvider/ToastProvider.tsx`
- Global singleton: `globalToastStore = new ToastStore()`
- Export: `notify()` function with methods: `.info()`, `.warning()`, `.error()`, `.success()`, `.dismiss()`, `.dismissAll()`
- Uses observable subscription pattern, not useState (to prevent subtree rerenders)
- Hook: `useNotify()`, `useToastContext()`
- Renders toasts in `<section popover="manual">` element using CSS Popover API
- Renders via `createPortal()` to top-most modal dialog or document.body
- Pausable auto-close on page visibility change
- Copy-to-clipboard action using `navigator.clipboard.writeText()`

### 3. IMPORTS & DEPENDENCIES

**package.json Key Dependencies**:
- React 19.2.4, React-DOM 19.2.4
- Zustand 5.0.11 (state management)
- @floating-ui/react 0.27.18 (positioning overlays)
- react-hook-form 7.71.2
- react-table 7.8.0
- @tanstack/react-virtual 3.13.22 (virtualization)
- date-fns 4.1.0
- classnames 2.5.1
- react-error-boundary 6.1.1
- effect 3.19.19 (Effect library)
- message-tag 0.10.0
- react-datepicker 9.1.0

**Styling**:
- SCSS with CSS layers (cascade layers)
- CSS modules (*.module.scss files)
- Lightning CSS for post-processing
- Vite plugins: vite-plugin-svgr, vite-plugin-svg-icons-ng

### 4. CSS & STYLING SYSTEM

**Main CSS Entry**: `/Users/kasperpeulen/code/storybook/storybook-eval/trials/2026-04-03T11-32-22Z-17399b74/project/src/styling/main.scss`
- Structured in cascade layers: reset → accessibility → baklava.base → baklava.theming → baklava.prose
- Imports from:
  - `/src/styling/layers.scss` - layer ordering
  - `/src/styling/global/` - reset, global styles, accessibility, fonts
  - `/src/styling/context/theming.scss` - theme variables
  - `/src/typography/Prose/Prose.mixins.scss`

**CSS Variables**: `/Users/kasperpeulen/code/storybook/storybook-eval/trials/2026-04-03T11-32-22Z-17399b74/project/src/styling/variables.scss`
- Custom property set at runtime: `--bk-device-pixel-ratio`

**CSS Modules**: All components use local CSS modules (`.module.scss`)
- Classes exported as: `cl` or `ClassName` exports
- Example: Button uses `cl['bk-button']`, `cl['bk-button--primary']`, etc.

### 5. PAGES & ROUTES

This is a component library without traditional routing. The demo page at `/app/Demo.tsx` showcases layout:
- Uses `AppLayout` with slot-based composition
- Shows Header with UserMenu, AccountSelector, SolutionSelector
- Shows Sidebar with Nav component
- Shows Content with Icon, Breadcrumbs, Panel
- Shows Footer with version info

### 6. FORM SYSTEM

**Form Context**: `/Users/kasperpeulen/code/storybook/storybook-eval/trials/2026-04-03T11-32-22Z-17399b74/project/src/components/forms/context/Form/Form.tsx`
- Provider-based form state management
- Uses `react-hook-form` integration
- Components: `Form`, `SubmitButton`

**Form Controls** (25+ input types):
- Basic: `Input`, `InputPassword`, `InputSensitive`, `InputSearch`, `InputFile`, `TextArea`
- Selection: `Checkbox`, `CheckboxTri`, `CheckboxGroup`, `Radio`, `RadioGroup`, `Switch`, `SegmentedControl`
- Dropdowns: `Select`, `SelectMulti`
- List selectors: `ListBox`, `ListBoxLazy`, `ListBoxMulti`, `ListBoxMultiLazy`
- Combo boxes: `ComboBox`, `ComboBoxLazy`, `ComboBoxMulti`, `ComboBoxMultiLazy`
- Date/Time: `DatePicker`, `DateRangePicker`, `DateInput`, `TimeInput`, `DateTimeInput`
- Complex: `TextAreaWithFileUpload`, `MultiSearch`

**Form Fields** (with built-in Label + Control):
- `CheckboxField`, `InputField`, `InputFieldWithTags`, `RadioGroupField`, `TextAreaField`, `TextAreaWithFileUploadField`

**Zustand Stores**:
- `ListBoxStore` at `/Users/kasperpeulen/code/storybook/storybook-eval/trials/2026-04-03T11-32-22Z-17399b74/project/src/components/forms/controls/ListBox/ListBoxStore.tsx`
- `ListBoxMultiStore` at `/Users/kasperpeulen/code/storybook/storybook-eval/trials/2026-04-03T11-32-22Z-17399b74/project/src/components/forms/controls/ListBoxMulti/ListBoxStore.tsx`
- Pattern: `createStore()` with `useStore(store, selector)` for performance (avoiding subtree rerenders)
- Maintains: items registry, focus state, selected item(s), keyboard navigation

### 7. REUSABLE UI COMPONENTS (40+ Components)

**Actions**:
- Button, ButtonAsLink, Link, LinkAsButton, IconButton, CardAction

**Containers**:
- Panel, Card, Banner, Dialog, Disclosure, Accordion

**Graphics**:
- Icon (SVG sprite system), PlaceholderEmpty, ProgressBar, Spinner

**Text**:
- H1-H6 Headings, TextLine, Tag, Prose

**Lists**:

**Navigation**:
- Tabs, Stepper

**Overlays**:
- DialogModal, DialogOverlay, Tooltip, MenuProvider, MenuLazyProvider, MenuMultiProvider, MenuMultiLazyProvider, ContextMenuProvider, ToastProvider, SpinnerModal

**Tables**:
- DataTableEager, DataTableLazy, DataTableStream, MultiSearch

**Layouts**:
- AppLayout (with Header, Sidebar, Content, Footer slots)
- DialogLayout, ErrorLayout, FormLayout, PageLayout, PublicLayout

### 8. HOOKS FOR DATA FETCHING & STATE

**Custom Hooks**:
- `useDebounce(value, delay)` - returns [debouncedValue, setDebouncedManually]
- `useDelayedUnmount(active)` - manages delayed unmounting
- `useFocus(ref, callback)` - focus management
- `useOutsideClickHandler(ref, callback)` - click outside detection
- `useTypeAhead(itemDetails, getItemKey)` - keyboard navigation typeahead

**Dialog/Modal Hooks**:
- `useModalDialog()` - control modal state
- `useActiveModalDialog()` - get currently active modal
- `usePopoverTracker(active)` - track popover state
- `useModalDialogTracker(active, dialogRef)` - track modal dialog

**Form Hooks**:
- `useToastContext()` - access toast notification system
- `useNotify()` - get notify function for toast messages
- `useDialogContext()` - access dialog close function

**No Direct Data Fetching**: The library doesn't include fetch/axios hooks. It's a UI component library.

### 9. BROWSER STATE READS

**No localStorage/sessionStorage/cookies usage found** in the library itself. However:
- Uses `navigator.clipboard.writeText()` for copy-to-clipboard
- Uses `window.devicePixelRatio` for pixel density tracking
- Uses `document.visibilityState` for toast auto-close pause
- Uses `window.matchMedia()` for media queries (device pixel ratio changes)
- Uses CSS Popover API (`element.showPopover()`, `element.hidePopover()`)

### 10. PORTAL USAGE

**Portal Rendering**:
- Toasts rendered via `createPortal()` to:
  - Active modal dialog element if one exists
  - Otherwise document.body
- Location: `/Users/kasperpeulen/code/storybook/storybook-eval/trials/2026-04-03T11-32-22Z-17399b74/project/src/components/overlays/ToastProvider/ToastProvider.tsx` line 251

**Modal Dialogs**:
- Use native HTML `<dialog>` elements
- Tracked in TopLayerManager stack

### 11. BUTTON COMPONENT PATTERNS

**Button.tsx** Key Features:
- Props: `label`, `icon`, `kind` (primary/secondary/tertiary), `disabled`, `nonactive`, `variant`, `onPress`, `asyncTimeout`
- Async handling: Shows spinner via `useTransition()`, waits with timeout

- Classes: Uses CSS modules with classNames utility

### 12. TESTING PATTERNS

**Button.test.tsx** (`/Users/kasperpeulen/code/storybook/storybook-eval/trials/2026-04-03T11-32-22Z-17399b74/project/src/components/actions/Button/Button.test.tsx`):

- Error simulation: vi.spyOn(console, 'error')

### 13. EXISTING STORIES

Located in `/Users/kasperpeulen/code/storybook/storybook-eval/trials/2026-04-03T11-32-22Z-17399b74/project/src/stories/`:

```

### 15. BUILD & VITE CONFIG

     7→import * as React from 'react';
     8→import { classNames as cx, type ComponentProps } from '../../../../util/componentUtil.ts';
     9→
    10→import { Input as InputDefault } from '../Input/Input.tsx';
    11→import {
    12→  type ItemKey,
    13→  type ItemDetails,
    14→  MenuProvider,
    15→} from '../../../overlays/MenuProvider/MenuProvider.tsx';
    16→
    17→import cl from './Select.module.scss';
    18→
    19→
    20→export { cl as SelectClassNames };
    21→
    22→export type { ItemKey, ItemDetails };
    23→export type SelectInputProps = ComponentProps<typeof InputDefault>;
    24→
    25→/*
    26→A `Select` is a single-select non-editable combobox.
    27→
    28→References:
    29→- [1] https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/combobox
    30→*/
    31→
    32→export type SelectProps = Omit<SelectInputProps, 'onSelect'> & {
    33→  /** Whether this component should be unstyled. */
    34→  unstyled?: undefined | boolean,
    35→  
    36→  /** A human-readable name for the select. */
    37→  label: string,
    38→  
    39→  /** Render the given item key as a string label. */
    40→  formatItemLabel?: undefined | ((itemKey: ItemKey) => undefined | string),
    41→  
    42→  /** The options list to be shown in the dropdown menu. */
    43→  options: React.ComponentProps<typeof MenuProvider>['items'],
    44→  
    45→  /** A custom `Input` component. */
    46→  Input?: undefined | React.ComponentType<SelectInputProps> & {
    47→    Action?: undefined | React.ComponentType<ComponentProps<typeof InputDefault.Action>>,
    48→  },
    49→  
    50→  /** The default option to select. Only relevant for uncontrolled usage (i.e. `selected` is `undefined`). */
    51→  defaultSelected?: undefined | null | ItemKey,
    52→  
    53→  /** The option to select. If `undefined`, this component will be considered uncontrolled. */
    54→  selected?: undefined | null | ItemKey,
    55→  
    56→  /** Event handler to be called when the selected option state changes. */
    57→  onSelect?: undefined | ((selectedItemKey: null | ItemKey, selectedItemDetails: null | ItemDetails) => void),
    58→  
    59→  /** Additional props to be passed to the `MenuProvider`. */
    60→  dropdownProps?: undefined | Partial<React.ComponentProps<typeof MenuProvider>>,
    61→};
    62→export const Select = Object.assign(
    63→  (props: SelectProps) => {
    64→    const {
    65→      unstyled = false,
    66→      label,
    67→      formatItemLabel,
    68→      options,
    69→      automaticResize,
    70→      Input = InputDefault,
    71→      // Dropdown props
    72→      defaultSelected,
    73→      selected,
    74→      onSelect,
    75→      dropdownProps = {},
    76→      // Hidden input props
    77→      name,
    78→      form,
    79→      ...propsRest
    80→    } = props;
    81→    
    82→    const InputAction = Input.Action ?? InputDefault.Action;
    83→    
    84→    return (
    85→      <MenuProvider
    86→        label={label}
    87→        formatItemLabel={formatItemLabel}
    88→        items={options}
    89→        role="listbox"
    90→        keyboardInteractions="form-control"
    91→        placement="bottom-start"
    92→        offset={0} // Make the dropdown flush with the select element
    93→        defaultSelected={defaultSelected}
    94→        selected={selected}
    95→        onSelect={onSelect}
    96→        {...dropdownProps}
    97→      >
    98→        {({ props, open, requestOpen, selectedOption }) => {
    99→          // @ts-ignore FIXME: `prefix` prop doesn't conform to `HTMLElement` type
   100→          const { ref: anchorRef, ...anchorProps } = props({
   101→            placeholder: 'Select an option',
   102→            'aria-disabled': true,
   103→            readOnly: true, // Make the input non-editable, but still focusable
   104→            ...propsRest,
   105→            className: cx(cl['bk-select'], { [cl['bk-select--open']]: open }, propsRest.className),
   106→            value: selectedOption === null ? '' : selectedOption.label,
   107→            onChange: () => {},
   108→          });
   109→          
   110→          const propsMerged = mergeProps(
   111→            propsRest,
   112→            anchorProps,
   113→          );
   114→          
   115→          return (
   116→            <>
   117→              <Input
   118→                role="combobox"
   119→                automaticResize={automaticResize}
   120→                actions={
   121→                  <InputAction
   122→                    // Note: the toggle button should not be focusable, according to:
   123→                    // https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility/ARIA/Reference/Roles/combobox_role
   124→                    tabIndex={-1}
   125→                    icon="caret-down"
   126→                    className={cx(cl['bk-select__arrow'])}
   127→                    label={open ? 'Close dropdown' : 'Open dropdown'}
   128→                    onPress={() => {}}
   129→                  />
   130→                }
   131→                {...propsMerged}
   132→                inputProps={{
   133→                  ...propsMerged.inputProps,
   134→                  className: cx(cl['bk-select__input'], propsMerged.inputProps?.className),
   135→                }}
   136→                containerProps={{
   137→                  ...propsMerged.containerProps,
   138→                  // Anchor the dropdown to the container, not the inner input
   139→                  ref: anchorRef as React.Ref<HTMLDivElement>,
   140→                }}
   141→              />
   142→              {/* Render a hidden input with the selected option key (rather than the human-readable label). */}
   143→              {typeof name === 'string' &&
   144→                <input type="hidden" form={form} name={name} value={selectedOption?.itemKey ?? ''}/>
   145→              }
   146→            </>
   147→          );
   148→        }}
   149→      </MenuProvider>
   150→    );
   151→  },
   152→  {
   153→    Static: MenuProvider.Static,
   154→    Option: MenuProvider.Option,
   155→    Header: MenuProvider.Header,
   156→    Action: MenuProvider.Action,
   157→    FooterActions: MenuProvider.FooterActions,
   158→  },

     6→
     7→import * as React from 'react';
     8→import { classNames as cx, type ComponentProps } from '../../../../util/componentUtil.ts';
     9→
    10→import { Input as InputDefault } from '../Input/Input.tsx';
    11→import {
    12→  type ItemKey,
    13→  type ItemDetails,
    14→  MenuProvider,
    15→} from '../../../overlays/MenuProvider/MenuProvider.tsx';
    16→
    17→import cl from './Select.module.scss';
    18→
    19→
    20→export { cl as SelectClassNames };
    21→
    22→export type { ItemKey, ItemDetails };
    23→export type SelectInputProps = ComponentProps<typeof InputDefault>;
    24→
    25→/*
    26→A `Select` is a single-select non-editable combobox.
    27→
    28→References:
    29→- [1] https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/combobox
    30→*/
    31→
    32→export type SelectProps = Omit<SelectInputProps, 'onSelect'> & {
    33→  /** Whether this component should be unstyled. */
    34→  unstyled?: undefined | boolean,
    35→  
    36→  /** A human-readable name for the select. */
    37→  label: string,
    38→  
    39→  /** Render the given item key as a string label. */
    40→  formatItemLabel?: undefined | ((itemKey: ItemKey) => undefined | string),
    41→  
    42→  /** The options list to be shown in the dropdown menu. */
    43→  options: React.ComponentProps<typeof MenuProvider>['items'],
    44→  
    45→  /** A custom `Input` component. */
    46→  Input?: undefined | React.ComponentType<SelectInputProps> & {
    47→    Action?: undefined | React.ComponentType<ComponentProps<typeof InputDefault.Action>>,
    48→  },
    49→  
    50→  /** The default option to select. Only relevant for uncontrolled usage (i.e. `selected` is `undefined`). */
    51→  defaultSelected?: undefined | null | ItemKey,
    52→  
    53→  /** The option to select. If `undefined`, this component will be considered uncontrolled. */
    54→  selected?: undefined | null | ItemKey,
    55→  
    56→  /** Event handler to be called when the selected option state changes. */
    57→  onSelect?: undefined | ((selectedItemKey: null | ItemKey, selectedItemDetails: null | ItemDetails) => void),
    58→  
    59→  /** Additional props to be passed to the `MenuProvider`. */
    60→  dropdownProps?: undefined | Partial<React.ComponentProps<typeof MenuProvider>>,
    61→};
    62→export const Select = Object.assign(
    63→  (props: SelectProps) => {
    64→    const {
    65→      unstyled = false,
    66→      label,
    67→      formatItemLabel,
    68→      options,
    69→      automaticResize,
    70→      Input = InputDefault,
    71→      // Dropdown props
    72→      defaultSelected,
    73→      selected,
    74→      onSelect,
    75→      dropdownProps = {},
    76→      // Hidden input props
    77→      name,
    78→      form,
    79→      ...propsRest
    80→    } = props;
    81→    
    82→    const InputAction = Input.Action ?? InputDefault.Action;
    83→    
    84→    return (
    85→      <MenuProvider
    86→        label={label}
    87→        formatItemLabel={formatItemLabel}
    88→        items={options}
    89→        role="listbox"
    90→        keyboardInteractions="form-control"
    91→        placement="bottom-start"
    92→        offset={0} // Make the dropdown flush with the select element
    93→        defaultSelected={defaultSelected}
    94→        selected={selected}
    95→        onSelect={onSelect}
    96→        {...dropdownProps}
    97→      >
    98→        {({ props, open, requestOpen, selectedOption }) => {
    99→          // @ts-ignore FIXME: `prefix` prop doesn't conform to `HTMLElement` type
   100→          const { ref: anchorRef, ...anchorProps } = props({
   101→            placeholder: 'Select an option',
   102→            'aria-disabled': true,
   103→            readOnly: true, // Make the input non-editable, but still focusable
   104→            ...propsRest,
   105→            className: cx(cl['bk-select'], { [cl['bk-select--open']]: open }, propsRest.className),
   106→            value: selectedOption === null ? '' : selectedOption.label,
   107→            onChange: () => {},
   108→          });
   109→          
   110→          const propsMerged = mergeProps(
   111→            propsRest,
   112→            anchorProps,
   113→          );
   114→          
   115→          return (
   116→            <>
   117→              <Input
   118→                role="combobox"
   119→                automaticResize={automaticResize}
   120→                actions={
   121→                  <InputAction
   122→                    // Note: the toggle button should not be focusable, according to:
   123→                    // https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility/ARIA/Reference/Roles/combobox_role
   124→                    tabIndex={-1}
   125→                    icon="caret-down"
   126→                    className={cx(cl['bk-select__arrow'])}
   127→                    label={open ? 'Close dropdown' : 'Open dropdown'}
   128→                    onPress={() => {}}
   129→                  />
   130→                }
   131→                {...propsMerged}
   132→                inputProps={{
   133→                  ...propsMerged.inputProps,
   134→                  className: cx(cl['bk-select__input'], propsMerged.inputProps?.className),
   135→                }}
   136→                containerProps={{
   137→                  ...propsMerged.containerProps,
   138→                  // Anchor the dropdown to the container, not the inner input
   139→                  ref: anchorRef as React.Ref<HTMLDivElement>,
   140→                }}
   141→              />
   142→              {/* Render a hidden input with the selected option key (rather than the human-readable label). */}
   143→              {typeof name === 'string' &&
   144→                <input type="hidden" form={form} name={name} value={selectedOption?.itemKey ?? ''}/>
   145→              }
   146→            </>
   147→          );
   148→        }}
   149→      </MenuProvider>
   150→    );
   151→  },
   152→  {
   153→    Static: MenuProvider.Static,
   154→    Option: MenuProvider.Option,
   155→    Header: MenuProvider.Header,
   156→    Action: MenuProvider.Action,
   157→    FooterActions: MenuProvider.FooterActions,
   158→  },
   159→);
   160→

## Full Runtime Environment Analysis - Fortanix Baklava Design System

I've thoroughly explored the codebase and documented everything you need to understand the runtime environment. Here's my complete findings:

**Entry Point File**: `/Users/kasperpeulen/code/storybook/storybook-eval/trials/2026-04-03T11-32-22Z-17399b74/project/app/main.tsx`

- App wraps `<Demo/>` component

**HTML Entry**: `/Users/kasperpeulen/code/storybook/storybook-eval/trials/2026-04-03T11-32-22Z-17399b74/project/app/index.html`
- Single div with id="app-root"

**Demo Page**: `/Users/kasperpeulen/code/storybook/storybook-eval/trials/2026-04-03T11-32-22Z-17399b74/project/app/Demo.tsx`
- Uses AppLayout with Header, Sidebar, Content, Footer slots
- Imports: Link, Icon, Panel, FortanixLogo, UserMenu, AccountSelector, SolutionSelector, Header, Sidebar, Nav, Breadcrumbs

### 2. PROVIDERS & CONTEXTS

**Main Provider**: `/Users/kasperpeulen/code/storybook/storybook-eval/trials/2026-04-03T11-32-22Z-17399b74/project/src/context/BaklavaProvider.tsx`
- Wraps app with `TopLayerManager` (tracks modal dialog states) and `ToastProvider` (global notifications)
- Hook: `useDevicePixelRatioTracker()` - tracks device pixel ratio and sets CSS custom property `--bk-device-pixel-ratio`
- Uses `React.use()` for context access
- No context providers in preview (preview.tsx is minimal)

**TopLayerManager**: `/Users/kasperpeulen/code/storybook/storybook-eval/trials/2026-04-03T11-32-22Z-17399b74/project/src/components/util/overlays/TopLayerManager.tsx`
- Observable pattern implementation with `ModalDialogStackObservable` class
- Tracks open modal dialogs in a stack (last-in-first-out)
- Hooks: `usePopoverTracker()`, `useModalDialogTracker()`, `useActiveModalDialog()`
- Maintains focus management for modal dialogs

**ToastProvider/Notifier**: `/Users/kasperpeulen/code/storybook/storybook-eval/trials/2026-04-03T11-32-22Z-17399b74/project/src/components/overlays/ToastProvider/ToastProvider.tsx`
- Global singleton: `globalToastStore = new ToastStore()`
- Export: `notify()` function with methods: `.info()`, `.warning()`, `.error()`, `.success()`, `.dismiss()`, `.dismissAll()`
- Uses observable subscription pattern, not useState (to prevent subtree rerenders)
- Hook: `useNotify()`, `useToastContext()`
- Renders toasts in `<section popover="manual">` element using CSS Popover API
- Renders via `createPortal()` to top-most modal dialog or document.body
- Pausable auto-close on page visibility change
- Copy-to-clipboard action using `navigator.clipboard.writeText()`

### 3. IMPORTS & DEPENDENCIES

**package.json Key Dependencies**:
- React 19.2.4, React-DOM 19.2.4
- Zustand 5.0.11 (state management)
- @floating-ui/react 0.27.18 (positioning overlays)
- react-hook-form 7.71.2
- react-table 7.8.0
- @tanstack/react-virtual 3.13.22 (virtualization)
- date-fns 4.1.0
- classnames 2.5.1
- react-error-boundary 6.1.1
- effect 3.19.19 (Effect library)
- message-tag 0.10.0
- react-datepicker 9.1.0

**Styling**:
- SCSS with CSS layers (cascade layers)
- CSS modules (*.module.scss files)
- Lightning CSS for post-processing
- Vite plugins: vite-plugin-svgr, vite-plugin-svg-icons-ng

### 4. CSS & STYLING SYSTEM

**Main CSS Entry**: `/Users/kasperpeulen/code/storybook/storybook-eval/trials/2026-04-03T11-32-22Z-17399b74/project/src/styling/main.scss`
- Structured in cascade layers: reset → accessibility → baklava.base → baklava.theming → baklava.prose
- Imports from:
  - `/src/styling/layers.scss` - layer ordering
  - `/src/styling/global/` - reset, global styles, accessibility, fonts
  - `/src/styling/context/theming.scss` - theme variables
  - `/src/typography/Prose/Prose.mixins.scss`

**CSS Variables**: `/Users/kasperpeulen/code/storybook/storybook-eval/trials/2026-04-03T11-32-22Z-17399b74/project/src/styling/variables.scss`
- Custom property set at runtime: `--bk-device-pixel-ratio`

**CSS Modules**: All components use local CSS modules (`.module.scss`)
- Classes exported as: `cl` or `ClassName` exports
- Example: Button uses `cl['bk-button']`, `cl['bk-button--primary']`, etc.

### 5. PAGES & ROUTES

This is a component library without traditional routing. The demo page at `/app/Demo.tsx` showcases layout:
- Uses `AppLayout` with slot-based composition
- Shows Header with UserMenu, AccountSelector, SolutionSelector
- Shows Sidebar with Nav component
- Shows Content with Icon, Breadcrumbs, Panel
- Shows Footer with version info

### 6. FORM SYSTEM

**Form Context**: `/Users/kasperpeulen/code/storybook/storybook-eval/trials/2026-04-03T11-32-22Z-17399b74/project/src/components/forms/context/Form/Form.tsx`

- Uses `react-hook-form` integration
- Components: `Form`, `SubmitButton`

**Form Controls** (25+ input types):
- Basic: `Input`, `InputPassword`, `InputSensitive`, `InputSearch`, `InputFile`, `TextArea`
- Selection: `Checkbox`, `CheckboxTri`, `CheckboxGroup`, `Radio`, `RadioGroup`, `Switch`, `SegmentedControl`
- Dropdowns: `Select`, `SelectMulti`
- List selectors: `ListBox`, `ListBoxLazy`, `ListBoxMulti`, `ListBoxMultiLazy`
- Combo boxes: `ComboBox`, `ComboBoxLazy`, `ComboBoxMulti`, `ComboBoxMultiLazy`
- Date/Time: `DatePicker`, `DateRangePicker`, `DateInput`, `TimeInput`, `DateTimeInput`
- Complex: `TextAreaWithFileUpload`, `MultiSearch`

**Form Fields** (with built-in Label + Control):
- `CheckboxField`, `InputField`, `InputFieldWithTags`, `RadioGroupField`, `TextAreaField`, `TextAreaWithFileUploadField`

**Zustand Stores**:
- `ListBoxStore` at `/Users/kasperpeulen/code/storybook/storybook-eval/trials/2026-04-03T11-32-22Z-17399b74/project/src/components/forms/controls/ListBox/ListBoxStore.tsx`

- Pattern: `createStore()` with `useStore(store, selector)` for performance (avoiding subtree rerenders)
- Maintains: items registry, focus state, selected item(s), keyboard navigation

### 7. REUSABLE UI COMPONENTS (40+ Components)

**Actions**:
- Button, ButtonAsLink, Link, LinkAsButton, IconButton, CardAction

**Containers**:
- Panel, Card, Banner, Dialog, Disclosure, Accordion

**Graphics**:

**Tables**:

- `useTypeAhead(itemDetails, getItemKey)` - keyboard navigation typeahead

- `useToastContext()` - access toast notification system
- `useNotify()` - get notify function for toast messages

    60→  dropdownProps?: undefined | Partial<React.ComponentProps<typeof MenuProvider>>,
